Site Index Models

Source: vignettes/articles/Site-Index-Models.qmd

Site index models included in the package

si_alemdag1991()

  • Function reference: si_alemdag1991()
  • Description: Alemdag (1991) national (Canada-wide) modified Chapman-Richards site-index and height-growth model for white spruce in natural stands Alemdag (1991)
  • Age type: Breast-height age
  • Coverage: Canada (all provinces/territories)
  • Species coverage: PICE.GLA

si_augerward2021()

  • Function reference: si_augerward2021()
  • Description: Auger and Ward (2021) Quebec plantation site-index model Auger and Ward (2021)
  • Age type: Total age
  • Coverage: QC
  • Species coverage: PICE.MAR, PINU.BAN

si_batho2014()

  • Function reference: si_batho2014()
  • Description: Batho and Garcia (2014) polymorphic Bertalanffy-Richards height-age (site index) model for lodgepole pine in the Sub-Boreal Spruce zone of British Columbia Batho and García (2014)
  • Age type: Breast-height age
  • Coverage: BC
  • Species coverage: PINU.CON

si_buckman2006()

  • Function reference: si_buckman2006()
  • Description: Buckman et al. (2006) piecewise red pine site-index model Buckmann et al. (2006)
  • Age type: Total age
  • Coverage: ON
  • Species coverage: PINU.RES

si_carmean1989()

  • Function reference: si_carmean1989()
  • Description: Carmean et al. (1989) eastern species site-index model set Carmean et al. (1989)
  • Age type: Total age
  • Coverage: NB, NL, NS, ON, PE, QC
  • Species coverage: ACER.SAH, BETU.ALL, CHAM.THY, FAGU.GRA, FRAX.AME, FRAX.NIG, PRUN.SER, QUER.RUB, TILI.AME, TSUG.CAN, ULMU.AME

si_carmean1996()

  • Function reference: si_carmean1996()
  • Description: Carmean (1996) northwest Ontario site-index model set Carmean (1996)
  • Age type: Breast-height age
  • Coverage: ON
  • Species coverage: ABIE.BAL, BETU.PAP, LARI.LAR, PICE.GLA, PICE.MAR, PINU.BAN, POPU.TRE

si_carmean2001()

  • Function reference: si_carmean2001()
  • Description: Carmean, Niznowski and Hazenberg (2001) polymorphic (Newnham) site-index model for jack pine in northern Ontario Carmean et al. (2001)
  • Age type: Breast-height age
  • Coverage: ON
  • Species coverage: PINU.BAN

si_carmean2006()

  • Function reference: si_carmean2006()
  • Description: Carmean, Hazenberg and Deschamps (2006) polymorphic (Newnham) site-index model for black spruce and trembling aspen in northwest Ontario Carmean et al. (2006)
  • Age type: Breast-height age
  • Coverage: ON
  • Species coverage: PICE.MAR, POPU.TRE

si_carmeanhahn1981()

  • Function reference: si_carmeanhahn1981()
  • Description: Lake States site-index model for balsam fir and white spruce Carmean and Hahn (1981)
  • Age type: Total age
  • Coverage: ON
  • Species coverage: ABIE.BAL, PICE.GLA

si_cieszewski1993()

  • Function reference: si_cieszewski1993()
  • Description: Cieszewski, Bella and Yeung (1993) preliminary variable-age site-index model for eleven Saskatchewan species Cieszewski et al. (1993)
  • Age type: Breast-height age
  • Coverage: SK
  • Species coverage: ABIE.BAL, ACER.NEG, BETU.PAP, LARI.LAR, PICE.GLA, PICE.MAR, PINU.BAN, PINU.CON, POPU.BAL, POPU.TRE, ULMU.AME

si_cieszewskibella1991()

  • Function reference: si_cieszewskibella1991()
  • Description: Alberta polymorphic variable-age site-index model for four major tree species Cieszewski and Bella (1991)
  • Age type: Breast-height age
  • Coverage: AB
  • Species coverage: PICE.GLA, PICE.MAR, PINU.CON, POPU.TRE

si_goelz1992()

  • Function reference: si_goelz1992()
  • Description: Goelz and Burk (1992) base-age invariant Chapman-Richards site-index model for jack pine in north central Ontario Goelz and Burk (1992)
  • Age type: Breast-height age
  • Coverage: ON
  • Species coverage: PINU.BAN

si_goudie1984()

  • Function reference: si_goudie1984()
  • Description: Goudie (1984) logistic height-age (site-index) model for lodgepole pine and white spruce in British Columbia (SAS-reference implementation; pine dry-site coefficients) Goudie (1984)
  • Age type: Breast-height age
  • Coverage: BC
  • Species coverage: PICE.GLA, PINU.CON

si_huang1994()

  • Function reference: si_huang1994()
  • Description: Huang et al. (1994) Alberta polymorphic site-index model set Huang et al. (1994)
  • Age type: Breast-height age
  • Coverage: AB
  • Species coverage: ABIE.BAL, PICE.GLA, PICE.MAR, PINU.BAN, PINU.CON, POPU.BAL, POPU.TRE, PSEU.MEN

si_hugarcia2009()

  • Function reference: si_hugarcia2009()
  • Description: Hu and Garcia (2009) interior spruce height-growth and site-index model (BC SBS zone) Hu and García (2010)
  • Age type: Breast-height age
  • Coverage: BC
  • Species coverage: PICE.ENG, PICE.GLA

si_kerbowling1991()

  • Function reference: si_kerbowling1991()
  • Description: New Brunswick polymorphic site-index model for softwoods Ker and Bowling (1991)
  • Age type: Breast-height age
  • Coverage: NB
  • Species coverage: ABIE.BAL, PICE.GLA, PICE.MAR, PINU.BAN

si_lafleche2013()

  • Function reference: si_lafleche2013()
  • Description: Lafleche et al. (2013) Quebec ecological-site potential-height IQS curves Lafleche et al. (2013)
  • Age type: Breast-height age
  • Coverage: QC
  • Species coverage: ABIE.BAL, BETU.PAP, PICE.GLA, PICE.MAR, PICE.RUB, PINU.BAN, PINU.STR, POPU.GRA, POPU.TRE, THUJ.OCC

This model uses fixed ecological-site curves rather than arbitrary site-index levels. The figure below shows selected example combinations of species and ecological keys for the potential curve set.
